# Flarelight

> Their newest release is the 2023 single Glimmer, put out independently on October 6, 2023. Brian May of Queen plays a guitar solo on it.

## Facts
- Who: Flarelight is an alt-rock duo.
- Genre: Alt-rock
- Based in: Nashville, Tennessee
- Latest release: Glimmer (feat. Brian May) (2023)
- Next show: None announced right now.
- Booking: flarelightofficial@gmail.com
